_comment: Financial assumptions (all values in CAD). CAPEX is derived from the BOM (see bom_scenario) plus the adders below and a contingency. Set capex_overrides.installed_cost_cad to a number to bypass the BOM and force a total installed cost.
_bom_scenario_note: battery_scope_only = BESS battery-scope items only (existing battery pack is $0). bess_less_solar = everything except the PV/solar-upgrade items.
_itc_note: Canada Clean Technology Investment Tax Credit (30% refundable for eligible business/farm solar + storage). Set to 0 to show pre-incentive economics.
